panels.title: Shop machine
panels.description: **1 = VictoriaMetrics scrapes the shop machine successfully** (`up{instance="shop:9103"}`, env-sensors target). 0 = no data from the machine at all.

panels.title: MQTT bridge (shop→opus)
panels.description: **1 = the shop→opus MQTT bridge is connected** as observed on the opus broker (`$SYS/broker/connection/shop.shop/state`). This is the alarm's fallback signal when the shop dies.

panels.title: Camera stream
panels.description: **1 = end-to-end shop camera stream healthy** (Pi→mediamtx→go2rtc→Frigate), from `frigate/werkstatt/status/detect`. This is stream health, not the detect switch.

panels.title: Frigate available
panels.description: **1 = Frigate process available** (`frigate/available`). 0 while the process or its MQTT connection is down.

panels.title: Alarm state
panels.description: **1 = the alarm is armed or in an armed-related state** (`armed_away`, `pending`, `triggered`); 0 = disarmed or arming. The disarmed privacy floor is `detect`/`recordings` going to 0.

panels.title: Recording while disarmed?
panels.description: **Privacy regression guard: 1 = recordings enabled while the disarmed profile is active.** Should stay 0 whenever `werkstatt_profile_active{profile="disarmed"} == 1`; this is the alerting rule `RecordingWhileDisarmed`.

panels.title: Detect / Recordings
panels.description: The authoritative Frigate switch states: **detect = 1 means person detection on, recordings = 1 means recording on.** Both must be 1 while armed and 0 while disarmed (privacy floor).

panels.title: Door
panels.description: **1 = workshop door open, 0 = closed.** A missing line means the door state is unknown (no retained message yet). While armed, an open door after the exit delay escalates to triggered.

panels.title: Devices online
panels.description: **Percent of Tasmota devices with a live LWT** (gosund-0/1/2, sonoff-0/2, irlight, lightservo). Needs `LWT_TOPICS` configured on opus, otherwise the line is absent.

panels.title: Connected clients
panels.description: Clients connected to the opus broker (mosquitto-exporter).

panels.title: Incoming message rate
panels.description: Messages received per second, 5-minute average.

panels.title: Outgoing message rate
panels.description: Messages sent per second, 5-minute average.

panels.title: Camera FPS
panels.description: Stream decode rate of the werkstatt camera (Frigate `/api/stats`). Sustained < 1 with an online stream means the camera feed stalled.

panels.title: Detection FPS
panels.description: Global inference rate (Frigate `/api/stats`).

panels.title: Connection quality
panels.description: Camera link quality percentile (Frigate `/api/stats`). Absent if the deployed Frigate version does not report it.

panels.title: Reconnects per hour
panels.description: Camera reconnect counter deltas over 1 h. Repeated reconnects point at the shop stream path.

panels.title: Stalls per hour
panels.description: Camera stall counter deltas over 1 h.

panels.title: Device LWT (1 = online)
panels.description: Per-device LWT state of the Tasmota sockets (`werkstatt_device_up`). A device dropping to 0 while the shop Pi stays up means the device itself lost power or its WiFi. Lines are absent until `LWT_TOPICS` is configured on opus.

panels.title: Temperature
panels.description: Workshop temperature from the env-sensors target on shop.

panels.title: Humidity
panels.description: Workshop humidity from the env-sensors target on shop.

panels.title: Illuminance
panels.description: Workshop illuminance from the env-sensors target on shop.
